scope: Representative route map, not exhaustive priority proof

papers.title: What In-Context Learning “Learns” In-Context: Disentangling Task Recognition and Task Learning
papers.reading_depth: Official abstract and metadata
papers.method_paraphrase: Task recognition uses pretrained task priors; task learning captures new input-label mappings. Their classification experiments distinguish these mechanisms.
papers.research_boundary: Useful conceptual distinction; does not by itself establish either mechanism in robot control.

papers.title: Instant Policy: In-Context Imitation Learning via Graph Diffusion
papers.reading_depth: Paper abstract and author project
papers.method_paraphrase: Instant Policy learns in-context imitation from one or two demonstrations using graph representations and diffusion.
papers.research_boundary: Demonstration-conditioned skill acquisition is legitimate ICL; it need not require multiple self-attempts.

papers.title: In-Context Imitation Learning via Next-Token Prediction
papers.reading_depth: Paper abstract and author project
papers.method_paraphrase: ICRT predicts actions from sensorimotor demonstrations and current observations without test-time policy parameter updates.
papers.research_boundary: Demonstration prompting does not establish learning from the robot's own failed attempts.

papers.title: RL²: Fast Reinforcement Learning via Slow Reinforcement Learning
papers.reading_depth: Primary abstract
papers.method_paraphrase: RL2 uses a recurrent state across episodes of an unseen task; slow training learns a fast adaptation procedure from observations, actions, rewards and termination flags.
papers.research_boundary: Fast and slow learning are established ideas; this is not a robotics-specific verification system.

papers.title: In-context Reinforcement Learning with Algorithm Distillation
papers.publication_status: arXiv, v1; official ICLR 2023 PDF also located
papers.reading_depth: Primary intro/method; source-learning-history distillation inspected previously; full AD not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Algorithm Distillation trains a causal sequence model on reinforcement-learning histories across episodes, enabling adaptation in context without network parameter updates.
papers.research_boundary: Learning-history distillation must be a strong baseline rather than claimed as our invention.

papers.title: Vintix II: Decision Pre-Trained Transformer is a Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learner
papers.reading_depth: Primary abstract and official proceedings
papers.method_paraphrase: Vintix II scales Decision Pre-Trained Transformer in-context reinforcement learning across diverse domains with flow matching.
papers.research_boundary: A generalist robot learning claim must address existing cross-domain ICRL, not compare only against BC.

papers.title: Zeva: In-Context Causal Learning for Generalizable Embodied Manipulation
papers.reading_depth: Abstract and method sections
papers.locator: Sections III-A, III-C, III-D and III-F
papers.method_paraphrase: Zeva encodes action-effect experience into within-attempt and across-attempt memories while all model parameters remain frozen during deployment.
papers.research_boundary: Own-interaction memory adaptation already has a robot precedent. Persistent interaction memory here resets for a new episode; cumulative retry success is not alone proof of learning.

papers.title: Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts
papers.reading_depth: Abstract and selected method sections
papers.method_paraphrase: Flux-OPD distills evolving contextual supervision using a context-free teacher anchor and conflict-dependent contextual corrections.
papers.research_boundary: Its reported domains are open-ended language tasks; it already constrains any novelty claim based only on evolving teacher contexts.

papers.title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
papers.reading_depth: Abstract and selected framework sections
papers.locator: Abstract; Section 1 local counterfactual credit and RE-OPD
papers.method_paraphrase: RE-0 checks bounded teacher corrections on student failure histories with paired execution; verified intervention benefit weights subsequent student distillation.
papers.research_boundary: Verified correction plus OPD is a direct overlap. The candidate must test future adaptation utility separately from current completion benefit.

papers.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
papers.reading_depth: Primary §3.1–3.3 and abstract; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Recursively accesses a hierarchy of video-demonstration phases/moments/clips at action time; recursion concerns access rather than weight generations.
papers.research_boundary: Recursive denotes hierarchical access here, not recursive weight improvement or autonomous learning of unknown rules.

papers.title: In-context Robot Learning Made Simple: A Democratized Recipe for Manipulation Tasks
papers.reading_depth: Abstract and introduction
papers.method_paraphrase: SimpleICL studies ambiguity in the information supplied by visual demonstrations and designs a visual prompt encoder and data protocol.
papers.research_boundary: A benchmark must specify what the prompt supplies and what new mapping the student must infer.

papers.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
papers.author_citation: Ross, S., Gordon, G. and Bagnell, D.
papers.reading_depth: Official abstract; established algorithm correspondence
papers.method_paraphrase: DAgger addresses policy-induced observation distributions by iterative expert-supervised data aggregation.
papers.research_boundary: Student-state expert labeling is established imitation learning; it does not alone identify an ICL mechanism.

papers.title: Learning to Learn Faster from Human Feedback with Language Model Predictive Control
papers.reading_depth: Primary RSS paper §III and abstract; full implementation not audited
papers.method_paraphrase: Fine-tunes interaction dynamics and applies predictive control to improve robot teachability on unseen tasks.
papers.research_boundary: Even improved teachability on new tasks is prior art. Autonomous physical feedback and explicit utility estimation require separate evidence.

papers.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
papers.reading_depth: Primary author method description
papers.locator: Author project Sequence Training and Effective Learning from Context
papers.method_paraphrase: RoboTTT uses fast-weight recurrent state for long context. In DAgger distillation, suboptimal actions supply context while human corrections supply targets.
papers.research_boundary: Failure-as-context and correction-as-target are not new. Fast-weight updates should be distinguished from fixed-weight ICL and durable slow-weight consolidation.

papers.title: RoboHarn-Evo: Evolving Hierarchical Physical Knowledge for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation
papers.reading_depth: Primary §§3–4.3 and evaluation criteria; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Keeps base model/executor fixed while revising task/action knowledge from physical support/opposition evidence.
papers.research_boundary: Verified knowledge maintenance and external-memory transfer already exist; their benefits do not by themselves establish weight absorption.

papers.title: Sample-Efficient Learning from Agent Experience
papers.reading_depth: Primary abstract; method outline only
papers.locator: Abstract; method section headings and scope
papers.method_paraphrase: Experience Distillation internalizes trial-and-error interaction context into weights using collected experience, evaluated on software and text-adventure tasks.
papers.research_boundary: Experience absorption is not a new concept. We have not reproduced its method or compared its performance in robotics.

papers.title: Decoupling Exploration and Exploitation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning without Sacrifices
papers.reading_depth: Official ICML paper §§1–4 and pinned original Cooking/City/Grid source; learner baselines not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Task-information bottleneck trains exploitation and exploration to recover relevant information, decoupling their chicken-and-egg dependence.
papers.research_boundary: Learning to identify task-relevant information is already central to DREAM; this diagnostic does not retrain DREAM.

papers.title: What is intrinsic motivation? A typology of computational approaches
papers.reading_depth: Primary journal taxonomy
papers.method_paraphrase: Intrinsic learning incentives distinguish information and learning-related objectives from external task reward.
papers.research_boundary: The learning-value/current-reward distinction cannot be claimed as new.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Unsupervised Auxiliary Tasks
papers.reading_depth: Primary abstract and authors’ auxiliary-task explanation; not a reproduction.
papers.method_paraphrase: Auxiliary objectives improve shared agent representations beyond the task reward objective.
papers.research_boundary: Adding an auxiliary head or loss is not novel.

papers.title: VariBAD: A Very Good Method for Bayes-Adaptive Deep RL via Meta-Learning
papers.reading_depth: Official accepted paper abstract/background and author implementation README.
papers.method_paraphrase: Meta-learn approximate task inference and condition decisions on uncertainty; public code also supports supervised task decoding.
papers.research_boundary: Learning task beliefs from history is a direct predecessor and required strong comparator.

papers.title: Meta reinforcement learning as task inference
papers.reading_depth: Primary PDF sections 1–2, Figure 1 and auxiliary-head architecture discussion; publication labeled preprint.
papers.method_paraphrase: Separates policy and task belief inference; uses auxiliary task supervision and explicitly compares shared auxiliary prediction heads.
papers.research_boundary: The learned factual-head probe substantially overlaps prior auxiliary-belief methods; neither an auxiliary head nor belief updating is a first contribution.

papers.title: Guided Meta-Policy Search
papers.reading_depth: Primary paper §§1–4.1 including DAgger-extension aggregation equations; not reproduced GMPS.
papers.method_paraphrase: Imitation meta-objective with task experts and aggregation of adapted-policy states.
papers.research_boundary: Student-state aggregation for fast task learning is direct prior art.

papers.title: Learning Belief Representations for Imitation Learning in POMDPs
papers.reading_depth: Primary proceedings abstract and author code README; complete implementation not audited.
papers.method_paraphrase: Joint belief and imitation learning with task-aware loss and belief regularization.
papers.research_boundary: Joint belief-policy learning is not our first contribution.

papers.title: Estimating Disentangled Belief about Hidden State and Hidden Task for Meta-RL
papers.reading_depth: Primary abstract and accepted L4DC statement; detailed likelihood implementation not reproduced.
papers.method_paraphrase: Hierarchical global-task/local-state latent inference with amortized belief estimation.
papers.research_boundary: Persistent task versus local nuisance disentanglement is already known.

papers.title: BEACON: Belief-Enabled Adaptive CONtrol for Imitation Learning under Uncertainty
papers.reading_depth: Primary full HTML §§1–4, particle filter likelihood, belief summary and latched-door evaluation.
papers.method_paraphrase: Structured Bayesian belief and uncertainty condition diffusion policies to probe and commit.
papers.research_boundary: Belief-conditioned probing to resolve robot hidden-state aliasing has a direct contemporary neighbor.

papers.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
papers.reading_depth: Primary full HTML §§1–3, related work and action/future mask; project venue claim not independently promoted.
papers.method_paraphrase: Failure rollouts supervise action-conditioned future/value while excluding failed-action imitation loss.
papers.research_boundary: Failed consequence learning without imitating failure is not new.

papers.title: Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning
papers.reading_depth: Primary abstract and identity; algorithm-family objective checked; not a full reproduction
papers.method_paraphrase: Teacher task selection prioritizes student performance slope and forgetting.

papers.title: Teacher algorithms for curriculum learning of Deep RL in continuously parameterized environments
papers.reading_depth: Primary identity and author institutional method description; implementation not audited
papers.method_paraphrase: Continuous task parameter sampling via a Gaussian mixture weighted by absolute learning progress.

papers.title: Prioritized Level Replay
papers.reading_depth: Official ICML proceedings abstract and author code README; full training not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Prioritizes level replay by learning-potential proxies including TD error.

papers.title: Evolving Curricula with Regret-Based Environment Design
papers.reading_depth: Primary abstract and official ICML record / author project; full implementation not audited
papers.method_paraphrase: Mutates replayed levels at student capability frontier using regret-based design.

papers.title: Unsupervised Curricula for Visual Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.reading_depth: Primary §§2–3.3 and Algorithm 1; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Fits task scaffold to meta-learner trajectories then meta-learns induced tasks, with mutual-information objectives.

papers.title: Meta Automatic Curriculum Learning
papers.reading_depth: Primary §3 and AGAIN subsection plus original abstract; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Transfers prior progress-niche curricula to new students and combines them with adaptive ALP-GMM.

papers.title: Rethinking Teacher-Student Curriculum Learning through the Cooperative Mechanics of Experience
papers.reading_depth: Primary §§3–4 and Algorithm 1; experimental algorithm details not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Experience units control the learner; reward is target metric increase after learning; cooperative values capture composition.

papers.title: Teaching Models to Teach Themselves: Reasoning at the Edge of Learnability
papers.reading_depth: Primary §§3.1–3.3; candidate short training, target progress reward and student promotion inspected; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: A teacher generates questions, student copies train, resulting target accuracy progress rewards the teacher; student is promoted over rounds.

papers.title: Improving Interactive In-Context Learning from Natural Language Feedback
papers.reading_depth: Primary §§2–3.3 and discussion; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Multi-turn RL with a privileged feedback teacher trains student feedback learning; auxiliary teacher prediction supports teacher-free transfer.

papers.title: Cross-Episodic Curriculum for Transformer Agents
papers.reading_depth: Primary §§2.2–2.3 and author project experiment description; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Orders cross-episode trajectories by learning progress, difficulty or demonstrator expertise; causal NLL trains Transformer-XL.

papers.title: Supervised Pretraining Can Learn In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.reading_depth: Primary §§1–3 and related-work distinction from AD; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Predicts optimal action from query state and interaction dataset; posterior-sampling-like online behavior can emerge without a learning source algorithm.

papers.title: Alchemy: A benchmark and analysis toolkit for meta-reinforcement learning agents
papers.reading_depth: Primary §3.3–3.4 and official symbolic/ideal-observer source availability; runtime not yet tested
papers.method_paraphrase: Latent chemistry structure with multiple trials and ideal-observer / oracle reference agents.

papers.title: Meta-Teaching: Curriculum Generation for Lifelong Learning
papers.publication_status: Anonymous preliminary submission; final venue/authors NOT_VERIFIED
papers.reading_depth: Search-indexed primary Algorithm 1 and §§3–4 fragments; full PDF request HTTP 403
papers.method_paraphrase: Teacher adjusts task difficulty / distribution using meta-student adaptation losses; major possible overlap, not an absence.

papers.title: MEWA: A Benchmark For Meta-Learning in Collaborative Working Agents
papers.reading_depth: Primary benchmark paper and original symbolic/task configuration code; environment training NOT_RUN
papers.method_paraphrase: Collaborative task and worker distributions with shared structure and stochastic mistakes; worker-specific adaptation.

papers.title: Task-Specific Exploration in Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Task Reconstruction
papers.reading_depth: Primary paper search material and official code README; full method NOT_AUDITED
papers.method_paraphrase: Task-reconstruction exploration; official code includes MEWA and Meta-World experiments.

papers.title: Recursive Self-Improvement via On-Policy Distillation for Reasoning
papers.reading_depth: Primary §§3.1–3.3 read in prior positioning review; not reproduced
papers.method_paraphrase: Detached current model with verified solution guidance teaches on-policy student; verified compact rewrites supplement recursive distillation.

papers.title: Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation
papers.reading_depth: Primary abstract only; full method comparison PENDING
papers.method_paraphrase: Selects knowledge-synthesis examples via retrieval potential and realized belief change; detailed control comparisons pending.
